articles.summary: Parallel Bio started in San Francisco. Juliana and Robert were roommates here when they founded the company in 2021, and ever since the Bay Area has been a home base for our investors, our scientific roots, and the vision behind what we're building. Last week we made it official.
articles.title: We're (re)planting our flag in the Bay Area
